{{Quotation|game|One look at this dry and desolated gorge tells the tale of its naming. Where once flowed a mighty river that shaped the land over millennia, now wind and sand make their way along deep channels, now little more than an echo of the past.}}

[[Thirsty River (outpost)|Thirsty River]] is a [[mission]] [[outpost]]. It is one of the three trials to open the path of [[Ascension]]. Having once been a river, it is now riddled with buildings created out of the remains of wrecked [[Margonite]] ships.

==Getting There==
*To reach Thirsty River, travel east from [[Skyward Reach]] into [[The Scar]]. From there, either let yourself die and spawn outside Thirsty River, or continue east and then travel south to Thirsty River.  You can also travel from [[Destiny's Gorge]] to get to Thirsty River.

==Mission==
*[[Thirsty River]]
**This mission is the sixteenth mission in the [[Prophecies campaign]] and the second mission in the [[Crystal Desert]] region.

==Notes==
*Complete exploration of this outpost adds 0.1% to the Tyrian [[Cartographer]] title.
*It is possible to avoid traveling through The Scar to reach this outpost. If you [[party wipe]] inside the area your party will be resurrected outside the Thirsty River outpost. This only occurs if the party has never traveled close to the [[Destiny's Gorge]] [[resurrection shrine]] and if you are closer to the Thirsty River resurrection shrine than the Destiny's Gorge one.
